scope: Owner-requested principal angles between the residualized history b and local observer ell response spaces. Use the existing fixed covariance, fixed rows, six response columns and 96 nuisance columns. No model, source, selection, budget, or original acceptance changes.

notation.whitening: Let W*C*W^T=I for the already declared working covariance, Z=W*U, and P=I-Z*Z^+. No full row-sized P need be formed.
notation.residual_columns: B=P*W*H_b and L=P*W*H_ell. Here b and ell label the three history and three local velocity profile amplitudes. The common observer-acceleration/glide columns are already included in U.
notation.gram: Use the existing Schur information F6=[[Fbb,Fbell],[Fellb,Fellell]]=[[B^T*B,B^T*L],[L^T*B,L^T*L]]. Thus all new statistics below require only the already computed 6x6 matrix.

method: Reuse the parent-contract finite/symmetry checks. For positive diagonal entries set D=diag(sqrt(diag(F6))) and Fbar=D^-1*F6*D^-1. Record the full and both 3x3 block eigenvalue spectra, normalized conditions, and numerical ranks under the rule below. These diagonal scalings change neither response subspace.

If each marginal block Fbar_bb and Fbar_ellell is positive definite and within the inherited condition limit, compute lower Cholesky factors Rb and Rell: Fbar_bb=Rb*Rb^T and Fbar_ellell=Rell*Rell^T. Form S=Rb^-1*Fbar_bell*Rell^-T using triangular solves. Do not explicitly invert the blocks.

Compute the singular values s1>=s2>=s3>=0 of S. They are the canonical correlations, equal to cos(theta1),cos(theta2),cos(theta3) for the principal angles 0<=theta1<=theta2<=theta3<=pi/2 between col(B) and col(L). Save raw singular values and the display values separately if a roundoff clamp is needed.

For display, theta_i=atan2(sqrt(max(0,(1-s_i)*(1+s_i))),s_i), using only the roundoff handling below. Report radians and degrees. A principal angle near zero means a nearly shared residualized response direction; an angle near pi/2 means nearly orthogonal directions in this declared metric.

Report the parent-contract column-normalized condition of F6 and the additional canonical-pair condition kappa_pair=(1+s1)/(1-s1), when its denominator is numerically resolved. These are different descriptive conditions. The canonical-pair condition is the spectral condition of [[I,S],[S^T,I]], whose eigenvalues are 1+s_i and 1-s_i. It measures overlap after separate within-block whitening and does not measure absolute signal strength.

Also report the information-retention factors 1-s_i^2. After profiling ell, Rb^-1*(Fbar_bb-Fbar_bell*Fbar_ellell^-1*Fbar_ellb)*Rb^-T=I-S*S^T, whose eigenvalues are 1-s_i^2. This provides an independent finite-matrix identity check and connects the angle diagnostic to the already required profiled history information.
proof: With normalized residual column blocks Bbar and Lbar, define Qb=Bbar*Rb^-T and Qell=Lbar*Rell^-T. Their column Gram matrices are identity, so Qb and Qell are orthonormal bases for the same two response spaces. Their cross Gram is Qb^T*Qell=Rb^-1*Fbar_bell*Rell^-T=S. The singular values of the cross Gram define the principal-angle cosines. Applying the same block congruence to Fbar gives [[I,S],[S^T,I]]; an SVD of S reduces it to three independent 2x2 blocks with eigenvalues 1 plus or minus s_i. Taking the Schur complement instead gives I-S*S^T, establishing the information-retention identity.
rank_and_nonestimability: For a symmetric positive-semidefinite normalized Gram M, report numerical_rank_tau(M)=count(lambda_j > tau*lambda_max), with tau=1e-10 inherited from the parent 1e10 condition ceiling. Report tau and the eigenvalues explicitly. This is a declared numerical rank at finite precision, not an exact or physical rank theorem. Eigenvalues near the cutoff are threshold-sensitive and must be labeled unresolved; do not truncate the design or alter the parameter fit based on this reporting rule.

In exact arithmetic, ranks are r_b=rank(B), r_ell=rank(L), and r_joint=rank([B,L])=rank(F6), and dim(col(B) intersect col(L))=r_b+r_ell-r_joint. If both marginal ranks are three, the number of exactly zero principal angles equals 6-r_joint. Floating-point zero angles do not by themselves prove exact intersections.

If both marginal blocks are well conditioned but F6 is singular or numerically unresolved, principal angles may still be reported as a descriptive overlap diagnostic. The parent six-parameter fit remains HOLD/NOT_ESTIMABLE or NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED. An angle calculation does not override that gate.

If a marginal block is non-positive, rank-deficient, or fails the inherited condition limit, do not silently use a pseudoinverse or discard directions to manufacture three angles. Report marginal spectra/ranks and PRINCIPAL_ANGLES_NOT_EVALUABLE_FOR_FULL_THREE_DIMENSIONAL_BLOCKS. A separate thin-subspace treatment would require an explicitly justified rank choice; it is not part of this supplement.

Finite nonzero angles establish only geometric separation within this fixed metric and declared nuisance span. Absolute information, parameter uncertainty, and the small-velocity physical-domain diagnostics remain separate required outputs.
roundoff_and_controls: The exact positive-semidefinite Gram implies 0<=s_i<=1. Preserve raw s_i. A value above 1 by more than 1e-10 is NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED; do not clamp it into a successful result. An overshoot at most 1e-10 may be clamped to 1 for display only, with ROUND_OFF_LIMITED status. Such a clamp cannot establish exact degeneracy or rescue a failed fit.

Use 1e-10 as the normalized residual ceiling for the orthonormality and Schur/angle identities, matching the parent algebra controls. If residuals fail, preserve them and classify the diagnostic as unresolved. Do not widen the threshold to obtain PASS.

When 1-s1<=1e-10, label the smallest angle and canonical-pair condition ROUND_OFF_LIMITED; do not report a finite large condition as resolved. Report the raw denominator and singular value. An angle returned as zero in this regime is a display boundary, not an exact null-space proof.

The lower-tier worker may add three tiny matrix controls to its existing focused tests: orthogonal spaces S=0 give three 90-degree angles; identical full-rank spaces S=I give three zero angles and a singular joint design; a diagonal canonical cross Gram diag(0.8,0.5,0) gives cosines [0.8,0.5,0], joint canonical condition 9, and retention factors [0.36,0.75,1]. These are matrix checks only, with no source-row replay or additional catalogue pass.
execution: No new source/row computation or matrix execution was performed by this researcher. The supplement is an analytic method for the upcoming lower-tier execution.
consumer: K03_PM implementation consumes this supplement alongside the unchanged parent contract. The independent reviewer checks both and the resulting numbers.
